'''Darren McBreen''' is an American media personality known for his involvement with conspiracy theories and his association with controversial media figure Alex Jones. McBreen has been a prominent contributor to the far-right media platform Infowars, founded by Jones, where he has worked as a producer and on-air host.

=== Career ===
Darren McBreen began his career in media as a graphic designer and video editor before joining Infowars in the early 2010s. As a member of the Infowars team, McBreen became known for his work on various documentaries and video segments that promoted conspiracy theories and alternative news narratives, often focusing on topics like government surveillance, the New World Order, and false flag operations.

=== Controversies ===
Throughout his career, McBreen has been involved in numerous controversies related to his promotion of conspiracy theories. Critics have accused him of spreading misinformation and fostering distrust in public institutions. His work at Infowars has been particularly contentious due to the platform's dissemination of debunked claims and sensationalist reporting.

One of the most significant controversies involving McBreen and Infowars was their promotion of the false Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting conspiracy theory, which claimed the tragic event was a hoax. This claim has been widely discredited, and Infowars, including founder Alex Jones, faced multiple lawsuits from families affected by the tragedy.

=== Association with Alex Jones ===
McBreen's relationship with Alex Jones has been central to his career. As a close collaborator and one of the key figures at Infowars, McBreen has been instrumental in supporting Jones's media endeavors and amplifying his controversial views. Together, they have been at the forefront of pushing narratives that question mainstream media, governmental integrity, and scientific consensus on various issues.

=== Public Perception ===
Darren McBreen remains a polarizing figure; he is praised by supporters for challenging what they perceive as mainstream media bias, while detractors criticize his role in perpetuating harmful conspiracy theories. His work continues to spark debate over the impact of alternative media on public discourse.
